item.description: Speaking during a fireside chat at Global Fintech Fest 2026, UIDAI CEO Saurabh Vijay said his objective is to build Aadhaar into a best-in-class digital identity infrastructure that can support its expansion internationally.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars
item.description: Tesla's new Cybercab robotaxis are now operating in Texas without traditional controls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an audit of these vehicles. US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. Experts suggest Tesla may challenge regulatory interpretations to deploy its vehicles.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Russia unveils new S-71K stealth missile for Su-57E amid potential sale to India
item.description: Russia has disclosed its latest S-71K Kovyor air-launched weapon designed specifically for the Su-57E fighter jet. This advanced system integrates the capabilities of both cruise missiles and drones, enabling effective stand-off attacks. With enhanced stealth features and cost-effectiveness for broader operational deployment, Russia is actively engaging India in discussions about potential joint production and technology transfer related to the Su-57E and its cutting-edge armaments.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Countries where you can buy iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cheaper than India
item.description: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models have officially launched worldwide. These devices feature the powerful A20 Pro chip and improved camera technology. Pricing for these flagship iPhones varies considerably across different countries. The United States offers the most affordable purchase option for both models. India's pricing reflects higher local taxes and import duties on electronics.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Max Thieriot turned 90-acre Sonoma ranch into vineyard, farm and retreat
item.description: Max Thieriot’s roughly 90-acre Sonoma County ranch has evolved since he and his wife Lexi bought it in 2013. The property now includes the nine-acre Bodega Thieriot Pinot noir vineyard, while the rest remains hillside, woodland and pasture. Though the actor’s family now lives in Washington state for most of the year, he continues returning to the ranch during the off-season.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Microsoft signs 'iron-clad' student privacy deal with teachers unions after NYC AI ban
item.description: Microsoft has signed a legally binding AI privacy agreement with the American Federation of Teachers and United Federation of Teachers, a week after Zohran Mamdani banned AI in NYC schools. The standard bars Microsoft from training AI on student data, tracking students or offering AI companion chatbots. School districts can cancel contracts over violations. Los Angeles Unified has paused student AI use, while unions want OpenAI and Anthropic to sign next.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Canada used recycled Christmas trees to restore Niagara River fish habitat
item.description: In an innovative approach, conservation teams are utilizing recycled Christmas trees to rejuvenate the coastal wetlands of Niagara River. This dynamic initiative, launched in 2016, spans over 1.64 kilometers, serving to calm wave action and lower erosion rates. By restoring vital aquatic habitats, the project aims to enhance the ecosystem, leading to a remarkable increase in both fish and shorebird populations alongside improved water quality.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Women's Asia Cup: Sri Lanka fight back from 33/4 to beat Pakistan, set up India final
item.description: Sri Lanka emerged victorious in a dramatic four-wicket win against Pakistan during the Women's Asia Cup semi-final. Despite a rocky start, they rallied impressively to chase down the target. Fatima Sana, Pakistan's captain, delivered a commendable performance, yet her efforts fell short. This thrilling victory sets the stage for Sri Lanka to challenge India in the forthcoming tournament finale.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Tharoor answers Chidambaram’s questions on Brics benefits for India; BJP takes digs
item.description: Shashi Tharoor defended India's BRICS summit prestige in contrast to Chidambaram's questions on its tangible benefits. The BJP criticized Chidambaram's remarks and highlighted Tharoor's differing viewpoint. Tharoor stated hosting leaders shows diplomatic convening power and value. He also noted BRICS represents a majority of the world's population. Tharoor's independent views often create internal Congress party discussions.
item.dc:creator: KUNAL VARMA

item.title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35M mansion: Why are neighbors worried about lake views?
item.description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million waterfront mansion in Bratenahl, Ohio, has faced an unexpected neighborhood dispute over proposed fencing. Some residents reportedly worried the original plans could interfere with their Lake Erie views, leading to discussions with neighbors. A section of the fence extending toward the beach was later scrapped. Despite the disagreement, local officials have welcomed Kelce, while emphasizing the importance of both community ties and privacy.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s $6.7M estate: Why did his Cheshire mansion lose value?
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo’s former Cheshire estate was listed for about $7.4 million in 2023 but later saw its asking price fall to $6.7 million. The 23-acre property has a seven-bedroom mansion, indoor pool, gym, cinema, tennis and padel courts. Ronaldo moved there after returning to Manchester United but later relocated before leaving England for Al-Nassr.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Pakistan mount stunning fightback, force tricky chase for England at Edgbaston
item.description: Day 3 of the third Test brought a thrilling turn of events as Pakistan demonstrated their resilience with a phenomenal 449 runs in their second innings, spanning nearly 97 overs. This left England with a target of just 130 runs to clinch the series. The highlight was a crucial 121-run partnership for the ninth wicket that stifled England's bowling attack, setting the stage for an exciting Day 4 showdown.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Bigg Boss 20: Qazi Touqeer on his bond with Arijit Singh; ‘Woh Crazypan Ka Baap Hai'
item.description: Qazi Touqeer, a contestant on Bigg Boss, reminisced about his long-standing friendship with the talented singer Arijit Singh, whom he first met on a singing reality show two decades ago. With great admiration, Touqeer honored Singh's artistry by performing 'Tum Hi Ho' during a recent episode. In a heartwarming gesture, Arijit Singh revealed his intention to tune in to Bigg Boss exclusively to support Touqeer.
item.dc:creator: etimes.in

item.title: Houthi advances puts India and global trade closer to the edge
item.description: Houthi forces are close to seizing control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, crucial for global shipping. This advance heightens concerns over trade security and energy supply chains around the world. India could experience rising costs and extended transit times for its goods. The Houthis are also enhancing their military capabilities, including integrating AI into weapons systems. This development poses new geopolitical challenges, especially for Pakistan and its defense alliances.
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: Instead of managing billions, Warren Buffett’s son Howard Buffett chose farming
item.description: Choosing a path less traveled, Howard Buffett, the son of Warren Buffett, dedicated his life to farming and conservation rather than finance. He skillfully managed farms in Nebraska and Illinois, prioritizing soil health. Warren Buffett supported his passion by purchasing a Nebraska farm for his son. As he transitions to the role of non-executive chairman at Berkshire Hathaway, Howard aims to safeguard the company’s culture following his father's legacy.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Mumbai mall entry case: Man used ChatGPT to create fake PMO docs, police tell court
item.description: A 24-year-old man was arrested for impersonating a PMO official at Jio World Plaza. He allegedly used ChatGPT to create fake PMO documents and an identity card. Police seized electronic devices and documents from his residence in Khar. His private security guard, an ex-Army personnel, was also arrested with a firearm. Both accused have been remanded to judicial custody by the court.
item.dc:creator: AHMED ALI

item.title: In Noida’s PG belt, buildings rise nine floors where two are allowed
item.description: Densely packed multi-storey paying guest accommodations have been built illegally in Noida villages. These structures often lack essential fire safety and emergency exits, posing significant risks. Many buildings violate building codes, with thin columns and narrow lanes hindering access for emergency services. Demand for affordable housing from students and IT professionals drives this rampant, unsafe construction. Tenants prioritize affordability over documented safety measures in their accommodation choices.
item.dc:creator: MEENAKSHI SINHA

item.title: Mamdani attends NYC 9/11 memorial despite calls from victims’ families to stay away
item.dc:creator: AASHISH VASHISTHA

item.title: Lessons from Ukraine war: Poland wants its own Starlink; where does India stand?
item.description: Poland is set to collaborate with Finnish firm ICEYE to establish a new military satellite communications system, aiming to lessen its dependency on foreign entities for vital battlefield communications. This project is projected to unfold between 2026 and 2030, incorporating local industrial partners. Meanwhile, India has had robust military satellite communication capabilities for over ten years, recently enhancing its maritime surveillance with the launch of CMS-03.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: 'We will never, ever forget': Trump commemorates 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
item.description: On the anniversary of 9/11, leaders across the United States honored the victims and reflected on the impact of the tragedy on current foreign policy. Speaking at the Pentagon, President Trump paid homage to the fallen and reaffirmed the nation’s determination, particularly in its dealings with Iran. Defense Secretary Hegseth reinforced this message, relating the historical attacks to the ongoing war on terror.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: ‘His time will come’: Rahane wants Sooryavanshi to wait as Samson returns
item.description: Ajinkya Rahane expresses his enthusiastic support for Sanju Samson's reentry into India's batting lineup, asserting the importance of maintaining their World Cup-winning squad for the upcoming Afghanistan series. In a recent video, Rahane encouraged young talent Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to trust in his instincts and play freely, while highlighting the need for mental resilience to bolster his career growth.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Days before 9/11, businessman took Twin Towers' lease; now, the rebuilding nears end
item.description: The final commercial office tower at the World Trade Center site is actively being built as the new global headquarters for American Express. This project has emerged after extensive planning and has navigated numerous hurdles. It acts as a tribute to the lives lost and rekindles commercial activity in Lower Manhattan, representing a crucial milestone in the comprehensive post-9/11 redevelopment plan.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: UP man stalks, stabs teen in neck after she rejects his advances; arrested
item.description: An Agra man was arrested after stabbing a nineteen-year-old woman. He attacked her on her way to work after she rejected his advances. The woman was rushed to a hospital for treatment of her wounds. Police apprehended the accused near the JCB Ground after receiving information. The sharp object used in the crime was reportedly thrown into a river.
item.dc:creator: SUDEEP LAVANIA

item.title: 20 runs in 6 innings: Pak openers register worst Test series in 35 years vs England
item.description: In a dismal display, Pakistan's opening batsmen faltered throughout their recent Test series against England, accumulating a mere twenty runs across six partnerships. This represented the team's worst performance in thirty-five years, with no partnership exceeding ten runs. Despite the collective shortcomings, Azan Awais managed to find some consistency, although his partners repeatedly fell victim to batting collapses, highlighted by a first innings disaster at Edgbaston.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Disha Salian’s father accuses Aaditya Thackeray, actor Dino Morea of her death
item.description: Disha Salian's father provided a statement to the CBI regarding her death. He has accused Shiv Sena UBT leader Aditya Thackeray and actor Dino Morea. The CBI is now investigating the case after a Bombay High Court order. Previously, Mumbai police concluded Disha Salian died by suicide in 2020. Her father petitioned the court alleging suspicious circumstances surrounding her demise.
item.dc:creator: VIJAY V SINGH

item.title: Watch: Putin takes swipe at 'so called' G7, says Brics accounts for over 40% of world GDP
item.description: At the Brics Business Forum, Russian President Vladimir Putin emphasized the growing influence of Brics, which now represents over forty percent of global GDP, outpacing the G7's twenty-nine percent contribution. He pointed out that these statistics illustrate the ongoing transformation of the global economic order. Furthermore, Putin and Prime Minister Modi participated in significant bilateral talks to strengthen ties.
item.dc:creator: TOI NEWS DESK

item.title: 'Trade barriers rising globally, India building bridges': PM Modi at Brics forum
item.description: "Today, while trade barriers are rising globally, India is building economic bridges. Since 2014, we have entered into free trade agreements with nearly 40 countries," PM Modi said.
item.dc:creator: AASHISH SAXENA

item.title: Rohit Roy slams TV actors, calls TV a ‘dustbin medium’, says many 'lack class, grace'
item.description: Rohit Roy expressed his belief that television actors often lack sophistication and elegance, labeling the medium as a 'dustbin' for its perceived low status. He emphasized that film actors exude a certain style and presence in public. According to Roy, the popularity generated on social media doesn’t translate to real respect for actors. Ultimately, he feels that cinema will always be regarded as superior to television in terms of legacy.
item.dc:creator: etimes.in

item.title: Bumrah bowls in full-squad practice as India step up Afghan T20I preparations
item.description: Jasprit Bumrah joined India’s full-squad training session ahead of their three-match T20I series against Afghanistan. The players went through warm-ups, fielding drills and an extended net session. Ishan Kishan briefly raised concerns after going down, but later walked off without apparent discomfort.
item.dc:creator: TANUJ LAKHINA

item.title: 'Still have curfew?': Warner takes dig at Barmy Army, fans hit back with 'Broad' meme
item.description: David Warner playfully engaged with the Barmy Army on social media, starting with light-hearted jabs at Saim Ayub's batting performance. He cheekily mentioned Marnus Labuschagne's ongoing century drought and poked fun at England's curfew struggles. The Barmy Army quickly fired back by highlighting Warner's past difficulties against Stuart Broad, to which Warner humorously suggested they need to find a fresh target.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: India's forex reserves surge record $44.9 billion to all-time high of $785.7 billion
item.description: India has achieved a remarkable milestone with its foreign exchange reserves soaring to an impressive $785.706 billion. This upswing comes on the heels of a notable rise in the previous week, primarily fueled by robust foreign currency assets. The central bank's proactive steps attracted more than USD 136 billion in fresh inflows. Conversely, there was a slight dip in the value of India's gold reserves during that period.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Nezam Hafiz faced Brian Lara in 1988; 13 years later, he lost his life in 9/11 attacks
item.description: Nezam Hafiz, a talented cricketer originally from Guyana, lost his life in the tragic World Trade Center attacks. After relocating to the U.S., he proudly represented the American cricket team. In his honor, teammates organized memorial cricket events in New York, which persisted for years following the September 11 tragedy. A bat used during these heartfelt matches now resides in a museum, serving as a poignant reminder of his legacy.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY
